comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
No Chrono Trigger references? I'm very disappointed. But yeah, this is one of what I like to think of as the UWO DB's unsolved mysteries -- things that exist in the DB, yet can be found nowhere in the game, or even in various Asian wikis. Closest I ever got to figuring out this trade good's existence was this Korean-to-English translation:

"Although we have not yet been implemented in the online age, we will introduce it in advance because it will be the one to appear someday. Haha"
URL: m.blog.daum.net/sweet89/1409453 (dated 07/14/2012)

BlakeC's probably right with the guess about it being beta related. Or maybe it really will be introduced one day in the future? I still wonder how it came to be mentioned in the DB at all, complete with an icon... and there are those -other- unsolved mysteries... but I digress. Cheers, and sleep well.

UWO is a game of discovery after all so curiosity fuels the need to know for some I guess. Good Luck with your search for the elusive Moonstone :P

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: It exists in the DB, but can be found nowhere in any version of the game, meaning its value, possible crafting purposes, and the like are mysteriously unknown. Even how it came to be in the DB is a mystery. I love a good mystery, and love unraveling them even more, so that's why I'm intrigued by such oddities. Isn't the allure of the unknown and exploring it a big motivator for most of us Age of Exploration fans, though?
